prompt: Implement a new document format detector that identifies document type from HTML structure and auto-selects the right parser. Register it in the existing parser selection mechanism.

assertions.name: plan_file_created
assertions.description: A plan markdown file was written to docs/plans/

assertions.name: has_two_or_more_approaches
assertions.description: The plan contains at least 2 explored approaches with pros/cons

assertions.name: existing_detector_pattern_found
assertions.description: Exploration identified existing detector/parser patterns in the codebase and referenced them

assertions.name: tasks_have_exact_file_paths
assertions.description: Every implementation task lists exact file paths

assertions.name: tasks_have_test_cases_with_markers
assertions.description: Implementation tasks include test cases marked with ✅ or ❌

assertions.name: registration_mechanism_addressed
assertions.description: Plan explains how to register the new detector in the existing parser selection mechanism

assertions.name: three_explorer_agents_dispatched
assertions.description: 3 explorer agents were dispatched for complex scope

assertions.name: tdd_skill_referenced
assertions.description: Every implementation task ends with a reference to /test-driven-development skill
